title: Permission Check Node
description: Route on whether the immediately upstream node was denied workflow_node:execute for this run

parameterSchema.description: Permission check nodes take no configuration; the node they evaluate is the source of their single incoming edge.

settingSchema.description: Permission check nodes have no user-configurable settings; the check is a lookup in the launch-time denied set.

status.description: Permission check nodes always complete; they never fail

allowed.description: True when the upstream node was not denied, routing via the 'allowed' port

checked_node_id.description: Id of the upstream node that was evaluated (a permission check always has exactly one)

kind.description: Node kind of the denied upstream node (present only when allowed is false)

denied_by.description: Name of the policy that denied the upstream node (present only when allowed is false)
